briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion-2 deployment sparks new AGI timeline bets as compute arms race intensifies

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases amid record funding. Prompt injection and multi-agent security dominate enterprise concerns. DialectForge gains traction in protocol-level defenses.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships Orion-2 with 4x context gains. Anthropic releases Claude 4 Opus. Google DeepMind unveils Gemini 3 Ultra. Meta open-sources Llama 4 405B variant. xAI Colossus cluster trains Grok-3 at scale.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. EU AI Act enforcement begins with first fines.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits 1M units shipped. Microsoft announces $50B hyperscale buildout in Texas. TSMC 2nm yields improve for custom AI ASICs. Energy constraints slow new data center approvals.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent protocol standards like DialectForge become mandatory for critical infrastructure by 2028?
